1.description: The main filter for Season 14: 7 levels from leveling to endgame, star tiers and holy grail tags.

2.description: The main filter plus Mystery drops: big drops hide their name outside town.

3.description: The main filter with a 10-cell health bar instead of stars: the fuller the bar, the better the item.

4.description: Roofoo Mystery with the health bar instead of stars.

5.description: The main filter with a 5-segment loading bar instead of stars, and Low/Mid/High tags on runes.

6.description: Roofoo Mystery with the loading bar instead of stars.

7.description: The main filter plus Slamfest Mode (FL8), a town level that shows the best corruptions and their prices for identified uniques and sets.
